decoding.notes: PINNED decoding parameters for the NoaCG Pro Phase 0 spike (docs/NOACG_PRO_PLAN.md §0.1: 'decoding parameters pinned in the fixtures'). A round whose sampling settings are implicit cannot be repeated, and 'the model got worse' has been the wrong answer to a settings change before. scripts/pro-spike.mjs reads this file and records the values it used into results.json, so a round carries its own settings rather than depending on this file staying still.

rationale.temperature: The spike asks whether the model has design taste, not whether it can be forced into one deterministic answer. Greedy decoding (0) suppresses exactly the variety §0.3 measures ('at least 3 genuinely different visual directions'), so a mid temperature is the honest setting for the question. It is the same value across both arms and both checkpoints - the arms differ in the exemplar block and in nothing else.
rationale.seed: Fixed so a re-run of a disputed brief reproduces the same sample where the endpoint honours seeds. Many gateway endpoints ignore it; that is a property of the endpoint, and the run records what came back rather than assuming reproducibility.
rationale.expectedOutputTokens: A complete three-file SPX template (document + rich commented CSS + the animation region) runs long. outputBudget() adds the reasoning headroom on top. A truncated emit reads as a broken model, so this is set well above the largest catalog design's own three files rather than tuned down for cost. RAISED 9000 -> 17000 on 2026-08-12, measured rather than guessed: at 9000 (a 17,000-token ceiling) `moonshotai/kimi-k3` truncated three of twelve EXEMPLAR-arm briefs, and only that arm - the 38,500-token exemplar block makes the model both think longer and write longer. The three that truncated were the most elaborate answers, so scoring the arm on the nine survivors would have silently dropped the briefs that tried hardest and flattered the result. A round is invalidated by a decoding change, so this one was re-run whole rather than patched per brief.
